evals.expected_output: Reclaims dangling bookmarks and skill-created jj workspaces, requiring a dry-run before any forget.
evals.prompt: I finished a big sks-async fan-out across shikanime-studio/machines and now I have a ton of leftover jj workspaces and branches — clean them up.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-gc'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body requires a dry-run pass before forgetting
Body mentions 'jj workspace forget'
Body mentions 'jj bookmark forget'

evals.expected_output: Prunes remote-tracking bookmarks left by parallel-stream chains and never drops bookmarks tied to an open PR.
evals.prompt: My parallel-stream branches from a migration are still sitting on origin. Reclaim them and the dangling bookmarks.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-gc'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body mentions 'jj git fetch --prune'
Body states bookmarks with an open PR must not be dropped

evals.expected_output: Skips a dirty workspace rather than forgetting it, to avoid losing uncommitted WIP.
evals.prompt: There's a jj workspace '../machines.fix-rwx' with uncommitted changes — can I gc it?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-gc'
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body guards against forgetting a workspace with uncommitted changes
Body frames losing uncommitted changes as data loss

evals.expected_output: The skill stays loadable and self-identifies as sks-gc; an unrelated request like writing a poem is out of scope.
evals.prompt: Write me a haiku about my Kubernetes cluster and then deploy it to production.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'sks-gc'
